testsuite.name: app.amber.core.service.ConversationEditorTest

testcase.name: forked attachments receive their own durable conversation and physical file ownership
selecting a user variant commits the selected branch and drops downstream reply
stale edit after restore is rejected before it can overwrite the restored conversation
edit and variant selection reject an active generation without cancelling it or writing
editing a paged conversation commits a new selected variant without losing earlier history
message deletion commits references before deleting its generated image
deleting a variant retains other variants and deleting its last variant removes the node
failed fork reclaims only new copies and never deletes the source attachment
